It is important to know the responsiveness of food demand because it is closely related to total revenue as it depends on the extent to which the quantity sold changes as the price changes. Total revenue(TR) from the sale of a good equals the price(P) of the good multiplied by quantity(Q) sold (TR = P × Q). An increase in price has two opposing effects on total revenue. It increases the revenue on each unit sold but at the same time leads to a decrease in the quantity sold which decreases revenue. Either of these two opposing effects could be the larger. Total revenue increases as price increases if the good has a more inelastic demand (0 < elasticity < 1). Total revenue decreases as price increases if the good has a more elastic demand (elasticity > 1).
